race.comment: ISAWYOU (3) showed a ton of grit on debut in the heavy (9) going with a closing second over 1100m at Canterbury. Likely improver on the firmer surface. Expected to go close. AVON CALLING (9) savaged the line first-up in the heavy (10) going when third to Tigroni in the small field over 1100m at Gosford. Clearly returned in good style and shouldn't be a Maiden for long. Go close. KISS OF GOLD (11) finished in the minor money at all three runs this time in and gets the services of Tyler Schiller today. Stalked the speed third-up in the atrocious going when second over 1100m at Gosford. Due for a change of luck. PARIAH TIME (6) just under a month between runs second-up when he faded badly to finish sixth over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Blinkers go on now and open to improvement.
